title: Affine purity by the standard chart and coordinate induction
statement: Fix ell, E and k as in [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], a separated finite-type k-scheme Y, and a natural d. Let p:A^d_Y -> Y. Given preservation hp for the specified p^*(-)(d)[2d], a boundary compactification c of p, and preservation h for its compact-support image, the exact restricted lowerShriek(c,h) is left adjoint to restrictedPull(p,d,hp) from [def-sfb-integral-restriction-functors]. The assertion supplies neither the preservation proofs nor a Brown comparison. It follows from the projective-line adjunction by the standard chart and coordinate induction.

source.place: Paragraph (2), the standard affine chart, dimension-zero case and coordinate induction

proof.text: Uniformly over every standing base, use signed Tate-line constructibility, integral tensor and pullback stability, and shift stability to preserve Dbc under every specified twist-shift pullback. The preimage argument for the minimal replete localizing closure extends preservation to Loc(Dbc): the unshifted functors are triangulated left adjoints, so their preimages are triangulated and closed under sums. Untwisted open pullback has the same property.

For A1_T use its standard open chart j into P1_T. The source is quasi-compact and the target is quasi-separated, so the chart is quasi-compact. Apply compact-support preservation to the open compactification (j, identity), and identify the identity proper pushforward with the identity functor using the right-derived identity comparison. Thus extension by zero preserves Loc(Dbc), so the open adjunction restricts by fullness. Apply the projective-line adjunction at T with the preservation just proved. Composing the two adjunctions gives R(qj)_! left adjoint to j^*q^*(-)(1)[2]. Cartesian coefficients and pullback composition identify this with u^*(-)(1)[2]. Compactification independence identifies the left functor with every chosen compact-support functor.

Induct on d with the claim that the specified compact-support projection is left adjoint to p_d^*(-)(d)[2d]. For zero, A^0_Y is canonically Y; the zero tensor power and shift are units. Transport the identity adjunction through that scheme isomorphism and the identity compactification. For the successor identify A^(d+1)_Y with A1_(A^d_Y), and compose the affine-line adjunction with the induction adjunction. Pullbacks compose, Cartesian twists pull back to the same twists, tensor powers add and shifts add. All shifts are even. Compact-support composition and compactification independence transport the resulting adjunction to the precise lowerShriek(c,h). Fullness and proof irrelevance identify the codomain restrictions with restrictedPull(p_d,d,hp). Work first with affineTraceTower. For the zero case and final coordinate isomorphism, view the scheme isomorphism as an open immersion, restrict its open extension/pullback adjunction, and compare its open compactification with the chosen compactification. The identity proper pushforward is identified using the right-derived identity comparison. The section-module tensor comparison identifies zero and positive Tate powers. The two opposite signed-power tensor comparisons make tensor by the degree-one line an equivalence, hence exact and flat; a K-flat single-complex model identifies the derived tensor of successive degree-zero powers with their ordinary tensor. Strong monoidality of derived pullback and its shift comparison give the successor functor isomorphism. Compactifications over the field supply the two factors.

proof_origin.place: Paragraph (2); J9 formal coordinate-tower induction and explicit functor comparisons

lean.statement:
theorem integralAffinePurity_induction
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (d : ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ K, IntegralCompactSupport.localizing
        (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) Y K →
      IntegralCompactSupport.localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val)
        (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y)
        ((pullTwistShift ℓ E (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y ↘ Y) d).obj K))
    (c : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification
      (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y ↘ Y))
    (h : ∀ K, IntegralCompactSupport.localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val)
        (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y) K →
      IntegralCompactSupport.localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) Y
        ((IntegralCompactSupport.image (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val)
          c.obj.obj).obj K)) :
    Nonempty (IntegralCompactSupport.lowerShriek
      (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) c.obj.obj h ⊣
        restrictedPull ℓ E (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y ↘ Y) d hp)
